Subject: Seeking Advice on Unmarked for Occupancy Modeling

Dear All,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out for your advice regarding a few issues I’ve encountered while using the Unmarked package for occupancy modeling:

1. How can I obtain bootstrap iterations? Currently, it shows zero.
2. How do I plot detection probabilities? While I can generate occupancy graphs, I am unable to create plots for detection values.
3. I would also like to extrapolate my presence points across a landscape; however, my models are not converging.

I have attached the code I am using. I would greatly appreciate any suggestions for necessary changes or additions.

Thank you for your assistance!


umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y = as.matrix(species1_det),
                         siteCovs = species1_cov)
# Building the occupancy model
occu.m1 <- occu(formula = ~ species2 ~ 1 , data = umf)

# detection formula first, # occupancy formula second,
summary(occu.m1) # Show AIC, estimates (on logit scale), SE, z-scores
AIC<- AIC(occu.m1, occu.m8)
AIC
# Predicting occupancy probabilities
occupancy_pred <- predict(occu.m8, type = "state")
print(occupancy_pred)
# Predicting detection probabilities
detection_pred <- predict(occu.m8, type = "det")
print(detection_pred)
predicted_data <- data.frame( cov1= species1_cov$ cov1,
                              occupancy = occupancy_pred$Predicted)
ggplot(predicted_data, aes(x = cov1, y = occupancy)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  labs(title = "Predicted Occupancy vs cov1",
       x = " cov1",
       y = "Occupancy Probability")

Regards
Deepali Chatrath
